concepts.name: 数据流转
concepts.concept: 一个有数据通道负空间的 D，把流转与产品首字母结合。
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original standalone symbol logo for the DataOps data operations product, intended for web app navigation, favicon and login branding.
Product idea: fragmented source data becomes reliable, governed, continuously operated and consumable data assets. This is a fresh independent brand, not Yak-ops.
Style/medium: professionally designed minimal geometric vector-like logo rendered as a crisp high-resolution raster, optically balanced, strong silhouette, generous negative space. Flat solid colors only: vivid rose-red #FE2C55 and near-black #17171B.
Composition: exactly ONE standalone symbol, centered, filling about 72 percent of a square canvas with uniform clear space. Truly transparent background.
Constraints: no wordmark, no text, no titles, no letters except when the specified monogram needs them, no presentation board, no background box, no gradients, no lighting, no 3D, no shadows, no texture, no tiny ornamental details, no watermark. Keep structural negative-space gaps broad enough to be recognizable at 24px. Avoid animal horns, yaks, bulls, wolves, shield icons, database cylinders, generic charts, infinity symbols and existing company logos.
Specific original design: a strong capital D-shaped emblem with a broad upright stem and a precisely rounded right bowl. Two robust rose-red geometric pieces form one coherent D silhouette. A single crisp horizontal negative-space data channel passes through the middle from the left edge into the D counter; a subtle forward-pointing triangular notch at its right end suggests movement. The result should be a memorable compact D with a purposeful pipeline cut, calm and authoritative, not speed streaks or a play button. Use red for the symbol; no black needed.

concepts.concept: 将 Data 与 Ops 的首字母连接，形成简洁品牌缩写。

Specific original design: a minimal three-port governance hub with a distinctive triangular overall silhouette. Broad transparent spaces separate the arms, smooth tiny corner rounding, radial optical balance. A bold unmistakable compact mark suitable for favicon.
concepts.finalRefinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: DataOps governance hub logo concept refinement.
Edit target: the provided generated three-port black and rose-red hub symbol on transparent background.
Change only the arrangement and connector geometry: replace the vertically symmetric Y-shaped arrangement with a CLEAR LEFT-TO-RIGHT CONVERGENCE SYMBOL. Place two black rounded-square source terminals at upper-left and lower-left. Connect them using two broad geometric elbows to one rose-red rounded-square central hub at middle-center. From this center run one chunky horizontal black connector to a black rounded-square output terminal at middle-right. The overall silhouette is compact, horizontally directed and optically balanced. All nodes are chunky squares, with broad transparent gaps between the two left-hand inputs. No vertical lower terminal, no upward symmetric arms, no Y letter.
Preserve: exact rose-red #FE2C55 and near-black #17171B palette, equal broad connector thickness, minimal flat geometric vector-like treatment, simple rounded corners, clean strong silhouette, truly transparent canvas, centered symbol filling about 72% of a square image.
Avoid: text, wordmarks, titles, extra variants, background boxes, gradients, shadows, animal shapes, horns, yaks, flowers, shield, database cylinders, tiny circuit details, hairlines or watermark. Exactly one standalone logo symbol.
